title: VDCores Qwen3-8B Shared-Instruction Window Plan
observation: The existing H200 instruction-capacity capture shows the shared runtime compiles 512 instructions per SM, while Qwen3-8B decode64 needs up to 2177 compute instructions and 15042 memory instructions per SM across all 132 SMs. The regenerated artifact now includes a bounded segmented-window manifest: 5 compute windows and 30 memory windows per SM, with every emitted window at or below the 512-instruction shared-table limit.
blocker: This is analysis evidence, not a runnable baseline. The VDCores paper row still needs builder/runtime support for a segmented or token-windowed shared-instruction schedule that reloads or advances instruction windows while preserving resident tensors, KV-cache state, dependencies, correctness, and per-window timing.
